tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every Medius documentation page (path, title, section). Start here to see what the docs cover.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the full Markdown of one documentation page by its path, e.g. "/library/clip" or "/native/commands/inject".

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Medius site: docs and Guide pages and sections, the dashboard, firmware releases and device reports. Returns ranked results, each with its matching sentence. Call get_page on a result's path for the full Markdown.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Medius docs for matching pages and sections. Pass a result's id to fetch to read its page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full Markdown of one docs page, by an id from search (a section's id returns its page).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_docs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Full-text search the Medius docs. Returns ranked pages with a snippet; follow up with get_page for the full Markdown." → after: "Search the Medius site: docs and Guide pages and sections, the dashboard, firmware releases and device reports. Returns ranked results, each with its matching sentence. Call get_page on a result's path for the full Markdown."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the Medius documentation and return matching pages. Use the returned id with the fetch tool to read a page." → after: "Search the Medius docs for matching pages and sections. Pass a result's id to fetch to read its page."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch the full Markdown of one documentation page by its id (the id returned by search)." → after: "Return the full Markdown of one docs page, by an id from search (a section's id returns its page)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
